Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Yes, we're well into another exciting tournament V:TES season, and that
means it's almost time for another Washington DC qualifier! Come on
down to the action-packed and not-too-hard-to-get-to Rockville,
Maryland on June 11th, 2005, for this year's Regional Qualifier event.

Finish in the top 25% of not-previously-qualified participants, and
you'll be able to compete in the Continental Championships of North
America (at GenCon in Indianapolis, IN on August 19th and 20th), Europe
(Budapest, Hungary, early (?) November), Australia (Canberra, October
2nd), or South America (São Paulo, Brazil, June 4th)... or all of them!

If you're coming from out of town and would like to find crash space
with local players, let me know, and we may be able to hook you up.
There are also plenty of hotels around the area, if you prefer the
luxury of your own bed - there is a Ramada, for example, a mile or two
up Rockville Pike:

http://travel.travelocity.com/hotel/HotelDetail.do?propertyId=2319

Or try travel.yahoo.com in Rockville MD (or use your own methods) if
you'd like to investigate other options.

There will be a "side event" of some kind, probably of some variant
tournament format (email me if you have suggestions or votes for what
variant to use) on Sunday June 12th, and probably casual gaming on
Friday evening (June 10th) for anyone interested in that.

The event details:

Big Game: Washington DC

TIME: Saturday, June 11th, 2005, 12 noon to 9 pm. Prelim rounds
should be done by about 7 pm. I'll be there at 11 am to
start registering people; play will begin as close as
possible to 12 noon.
PLACE: Dream Wizards:
11772 Parklawn Drive
Rockville, MD 20852
301-881-3530
DIRECTIONS: http://www.dreamwizards.com (http://www.mapquest.com
probably has better directions from out of state)
FORMAT: VEKN sanctioned constructed Championship Qualifier
tourney, 3 rounds + final.
The multi-judge system will not be used; Joshua Duffin
will be head judge and organizer.
Current V:EKN tournament rules can be found at:
www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=veknRules.html
ENTRY FEE: $5.00 (will go towards prizes)
PRIZES: Eternal fame, the undying admiration of the V:TES world,
invitations to the 2005 North American and other
Continental Championships... and, of course, booster
packs. Many booster packs. And special Qualifier
T-shirts, lots of promo cards, and maybe something else
cool.
QUESTIONS: Joshua Duffin, jtdu...@yahoo.com.

sincerely yours,

Joshua Duffin
V:EKN Prince of Washington DC

Messages.Author: Fabio "Sooner" Macedo
Messages.Body:



Heh :)

Not to be even more anal, but "our Gen*Con" (EIRPG) happens around the
end of May/beginning of June each year.
So every year when the SAC is to be held in Brazil, it would be
problematic to schedule it outside the Con. Thousands of RPG players
from all over the country come to that event. RPG playerbases from
most major cities organize themselves to rent buses and stuff to come
to the event. V:tES playes just have to follow the flow, applying for
these cheaper caravans to come.
Since many V:tES are algo tabletop gamers, it's one trip per year
instead of two, something not all of them can afford - not only
because of money but also available time, getting license from work
and such.


